SPIREPLUS.settings_page.description: RitsuLib settings page for Spire Plus private beta testing.
SPIREPLUS-MIGRATION_STATUS.title: Migration Status
SPIREPLUS-MIGRATION_STATUS.description: Read-only status for the current RitsuLib-only settings surface.
SPIREPLUS-RITSULIB_ONLY_SUMMARY.title: RitsuLib-only mod surface
SPIREPLUS-RITSULIB_ONLY_SUMMARY.descript: This page is registered through RitsuLib. Spire Plus uses RitsuLib for settings persistence, content registration, patch metadata, and saved marker state.
SPIREPLUS-REQUIRED_RUNTIME_DEPENDENCY.de: Install the runtime pack under the game mods/STS2-RitsuLib folder before enabling Spire Plus.
SPIREPLUS-STABLE_MANIFEST_ID.title: Technical id
SPIREPLUS-STABLE_MANIFEST_ID.description: This id remains only for the manifest, install folder, saves, and compatibility. Player-facing UI should say Spire Plus.
SPIREPLUS-PROOF_BOUNDARY.title: Evidence boundary
SPIREPLUS-PROOF_BOUNDARY.subtitle: Settings screenshots prove UI visibility only.
SPIREPLUS-PROOF_BOUNDARY.description: Gameplay, clicked Ancient screens, save/load, co-op, and release readiness still need separate evidence.
SPIREPLUS-PREVIEW_TOOLS.title: Preview Tools
SPIREPLUS-PREVIEW_TOOLS.description: Controls for Crystal Sphere peek and transform prediction.
SPIREPLUS-ENABLE_CRYSTAL_SPHERE_PEEK.des: Show the peek overlay for Crystal Sphere when supported.
SPIREPLUS-CRYSTAL_SPHERE_MASK_ALPHA.desc: Opacity of the Crystal Sphere peek mask.
SPIREPLUS-ENABLE_TRANSFORM_PREDICTION.de: Show predicted transform outcomes when supported.
SPIREPLUS-TRANSFORM_PREDICTION_ALWAYS_ON: Show transform prediction without requiring a modifier key.
SPIREPLUS-SHOW_PREVIEW_DEBUG_LOGS.title: Preview diagnostics logs
SPIREPLUS-SHOW_PREVIEW_DEBUG_LOGS.descri: Emit extra preview-tool diagnostics to the log.
